name: Diaphragm Wall (D-Wall)
source: WTC 2022 Fig 15
description: Reinforced concrete perimeter diaphragm wall enclosing the 13.4m wide cut-and-cover station box down to fresh Delhi quartzite bedrock. Acts as both earth retaining structure and groundwater cutoff wall.

specifications.Concrete Grade: M40 Tremie Concrete with water-repellent admixtures

inspectionProtocol: Check for groundwater seepage or damp patches along vertical construction joints
Inspect crack width using optical comparator (limit <= 0.2 mm for water-retaining structures)
Verify inclinometer readings for horizontal wall deflection during excavation stages
safetyNotice: Inspection only. Any water leaks exceeding 10 L/min require immediate polyurethane chemical grouting.

name: Station Box Roof Slab
source: WTC 2022 Fig 15 annotation
description: Heavy reinforced concrete roof slab supporting 4.36m of sandy silt overburden, city traffic, utility pipes, and surface structures along Sadar Bazar corridor.

specifications.Waterproofing Membrane: Bonded SBS modified bituminous membrane with protective screed

inspectionProtocol: Inspect soffit for water dripping or efflorescence deposits
Check utility penetrations and expansion joints for elastomeric seal integrity
Verify structural vibration amplitude during peak heavy freight train/road traffic

name: Concourse Level Slab
source: WTC 2022 Fig 15
description: Suspended RC floor slab carrying passenger ticketing concourse, AFC fare gates, customer service booths, and egress stairwell/lift openings.
inspectionProtocol: Inspect floor tile joint grouting around stairwell void perimeter
Check deflection sensors on central suspended beam spans
Inspect edge trim around elevator shaft penetrations

name: Reinforced Concrete Grid Columns
source: WTC 2022 Fig 15 structural grid
description: Heavy circular RC columns spaced along longitudinal structural Grid C at 10m centers, transmitting vertical overburden and floor loads directly to the base foundation slab.

specifications.Reinforcement: High-yield Fe500D rebar with spiral containment ties

inspectionProtocol: Inspect column base collars for shear microcracks
Check vertical plumbness tolerance (limit <= 1:500)
Examine Emergency Stop Plunger (ESP) mounting brackets and conduit earthing

name: Upper Bored TBM Running Tunnel
source: Gall Zeidler Consultants DC-05 project sheet
description: Circular bored running tunnel excavated by Earth Pressure Balance (EPB) TBM, accommodating the northbound track toward Janakpuri West.

specifications.Lining Type: Universal tapered precast concrete segmental rings (5+1 key)

inspectionProtocol: Measure tunnel ring ovalization / diametrical convergence (tolerance <= 15 mm)
Check segment radial joint bolts for specified torque
Inspect segment EPDM rubber gaskets for water ingress

name: Deep Lower Bored TBM Running Tunnel
source: Gall Zeidler Consultants DC-05 sheet & WTC Fig 15
description: Deep lower bored running tunnel stacked vertically beneath the upper tunnel at 32.10m depth, bored through massive fresh Delhi quartzite bedrock.
inspectionProtocol: Inspect invert segment grout injection ports for seepage under high hydrostatic head
Check convergence monitoring optical prism targets
Inspect track drainage sump collector channel
safetyNotice: Vertical gap conflict notice: Text states gap < 6.35m, but cross-section drawings show 14.7m rail difference. Tagged provisional pending DMRC author verification.

name: NATM Mined Cross-Passage (CP-01)
source: Gall Zeidler Consultants DC-05 project sheet
description: Mined cross-passage connecting stacked running tunnels for emergency egress and maintenance bypass, excavated using New Austrian Tunnelling Method (NATM) with steel ribs and shotcrete.

specifications.Secondary Lining: 300 mm cast-in-place waterproof RC with PVC membrane
specifications.Fire Separation Doors: Class 2-hour rated sliding fire blast doors

inspectionProtocol: Test emergency fire door closure speed and positive latching
Inspect pressure relief dampers and pressurization fan intakes
Check junction waterproofing collars at TBM ring break-in and break-out openings

name: Historical Heritage Brick Sewer
source: WTC 2022 paper text (~10m depth crossing)
description: Century-old British-era arch brick masonry sewer crossing directly adjacent to the station boundary. High vulnerability to settlement, vibration, and groundwater drawdown during excavation.

specifications.Protection Measure: Compaction grouting and real-time hydrostatic tilt sensors

inspectionProtocol: Verify automated hydrostatic levelling cells (HLC) for settlement (< 5 mm trigger)
Inspect CCTV sewer survey logs for joint separation or mortar washout
Check vibration seismograph velocity (< 5 mm/s PPV threshold)

name: Hydrogeological Water Table & Bedrock Interface
source: WTC 2022 paper geotechnical summary
description: Static groundwater table located at 5.0 to 6.0m depth, transitioning from loose sandy silt (0-4.5m) to weathered quartzite (4.5-21.5m) and hard bedrock below 21.5m.
inspectionProtocol: Check vibrating wire piezometers for seasonal water table fluctuation
Inspect recharge well injection pressures near sensitive heritage foundations
Sample water for sulfate and chloride concentrations (corrosion risk to concrete)

name: Automatic Fare Collection (AFC) Turnstiles
source: Standard DMRC Phase IV operational equipment
description: High-throughput bi-directional turnstile gate array separating paid and unpaid concourse zones. Equipped with contactless RFID readers, QR optical scanners, and rapid motorized acrylic flaps.

specifications.Card Validator: ISO/IEC 14443 Type A/B Contactless (NCMC & DMRC Smart Card)
specifications.Emergency Fail-Safe: Auto-retract to wide open on fire alarm signal

inspectionProtocol: Test emergency fire alarm interface flap auto-open fail-safe
Verify optical intrusion sensors for tailgating detection
Inspect card reader transaction latency (< 300 ms response)

name: Ticket Vending Machine (TVM) Kiosk Array
source: Standard DMRC Phase IV concourse equipment
description: Interactive self-service kiosks along the concourse west wall for purchasing QR journey tokens, checking smart card balances, and instant UPI/cash card top-up.

specifications.Payment Options: UPI Dynamic QR, Debit/Credit Card, Banknotes, Coins
specifications.Network Protocol: Encrypted Ethernet link to Station Computer (SC)

inspectionProtocol: Verify touch accuracy and touchscreen calibration
Check banknote feeder acceptance and coin hopper capacity
Inspect uninterruptible power supply (UPS) 30-minute backup battery

name: Full-Height Platform Screen Doors (PSD)
source: Standard DMRC Phase IV underground platform design
description: Full-height tempered safety glass barrier wall isolating the air-conditioned passenger platform from the train tunnel. Enhances passenger life safety, reduces piston wind air drag, and saves HVAC energy.

specifications.System Height: 2.40 m full-height enclosure with header box
specifications.Interlock: CBTC GoA2/GoA4 signaling drive interlock (SIL 4 safety)

inspectionProtocol: Verify door synchronization with train docking alignment tolerance (+/- 300 mm)
Test manual emergency breakout push handle from track side
Inspect obstruction detection sensitivity (stops and reopens on 10 mm object)

name: Passenger Information Display System (PIDS)
source: DMRC Phase IV underground PIDS standard
description: Dual-sided suspended electronic LED matrix displays providing real-time train ETA countdowns, destination announcements, and emergency broadcast alerts.

specifications.Display Technology: Full-color P4 SMD LED Matrix (Amber / Green / Red)
specifications.Update Rate: 1 Hz live telemetry feed from Centralized OCC
specifications.Audio Sync: Synchronized with station Public Address (PA) speakers

inspectionProtocol: Check LED module pixel failure rate (zero dead pixels in text area)
Test emergency message override latency (< 1 second)
Verify structural suspension safety wire ropes and vibration dampers

name: UIC 60 Ballastless Slab Track
source: Sadar Bazar Tunnel Data & Measurements doc
description: Continuously welded UIC 60 (60 kg/m) head-hardened steel rails anchored into cast-in-place concrete plinths using elastic rail fastenings with elastomeric vibration damping pads.

specifications.Fastening System: Vossloh / Pandrol elastic spring clips with rubber pads
specifications.Track Offset: 1.885 m from tunnel centerline to track center

inspectionProtocol: Measure track gauge using calibrated digital gauge trolley (1435 +3/-1 mm)
Inspect rail top profile for corrugation or rolling contact fatigue (RCF)
Verify clip clamping torque and insulating toe bushing integrity

name: Third Rail / Traction Power System
source: Standard DMRC underground rolling stock electrification
description: Bottom-contact traction conductor rail mounted on fiberglass insulating brackets with high-visibility yellow protective shroud, delivering DC propulsion power to trains.

specifications.Voltage: 750 V DC (or 25 kV AC overhead catenary depending on rolling stock spec)
specifications.Sectionalizing: Motorized track disconnect switches linked to SCADA

inspectionProtocol: Measure electrical clearance between live rail and rolling stock dynamic envelope
Inspect insulator brackets for flashover tracking or dust contamination
Test emergency traction power trip loop from Station Control Room
safetyNotice: HAZARD: 750V DC live voltage. Work strictly under Permit to Work (PTW) with confirmed earthing.

name: Emergency Stop Plunger (ESP) Box
source: DMRC Underground Life Safety Manual
description: High-visibility red push-button station mounted on platform columns. In the event of a passenger on the trackway or docking anomaly, pressing the ESP instantly removes traction power and commands emergency train stop.

specifications.Enclosure: IP65 die-cast aluminium with tamper-evident seal and glass flap
specifications.Response Time: < 150 ms to traction breaker trip and ATS signal red
specifications.Location: Mounted at 1.4m height on platform columns at 20m intervals

inspectionProtocol: Verify unbroken tamper seal and mechanical return spring tension
Test signal feedback verification lamp on Station Control Room mimic panel
Confirm warning buzzer sounding on OCC controller console upon activation
safetyNotice: Operational use strictly restricted to life-safety emergency. Unauthorized activation is a punishable offense.

name: High-Capacity Multi-Level Egress Staircases
source: Standard NFPA 130 / transit egress calculation
description: Cast-in-place reinforced concrete egress flights connecting Concourse, Upper Platform, Intermediate Plant, and Lower Platform. Designed to evacuate full platform occupant load within 4 minutes under NFPA 130.

specifications.Treads & Risers: 35 / 46 / 37 steps per flight (riser 176-177 mm, tread 391-457 mm)
specifications.Treads Finish: Light granite with 70mm yellow slip-resistant nosing strips
specifications.Handrails: Dual-height stainless steel handrails with glass balustrade

inspectionProtocol: Inspect step nosing slip-resistance coefficient of friction (COF > 0.6)
Verify emergency battery-backed stairwell illumination (> 50 lux at floor level)
Check handrail rigidity and continuous grasping surface

name: Glass Transit Passenger Elevator & Hoistway
source: DMRC Barrier-Free Accessibility Standard
description: Through-type panoramic glass transit elevator serving all 4 levels, providing barrier-free access for wheelchair users, elderly passengers, and emergency response teams.

specifications.Shaft Footprint: 2.40 m x 2.40 m glass and structural steel hoistway
specifications.Cabin Dimensions: 2.00 m wide x 2.00 m deep x 2.40 m high
specifications.Stops: 4 levels (Concourse -10.2m, Upper Plat -16.3m, Intermediate -24.5m, Lower Plat -31.0m)

inspectionProtocol: Test fire recall switch (auto-homing to Concourse with doors open)
Inspect door safety photo-curtain infrared sensors
Verify cabin emergency intercom connectivity to Station Controller

name: Generic Station Design Life & Fire Resistance
nameHindi: स्टेशन डिज़ाइन लाइफ़ और अग्नि प्रतिरोध
source: RDSO draft Model DBR, Jan 2022 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic reference requirements for durability and fire performance of metro station structures. These values are informational and do not replace the Sadar Bazar project specification.
inspectionProtocol: Confirm project-specific fire-resistance schedule before relying on this generic reference
Review durability and repair records against the approved design-life strategy
Verify monitoring thresholds are defined for angular distortion

name: Generic Groundwater, Leakage & Flotation Controls
source: RDSO draft Model DBR, Jan 2022 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic waterproofing and excavation-control reference for underground stations, including leakage, flotation, and external dewatering constraints.

specifications.Wall Preference: Diaphragm walls preferred for deeper stations

inspectionProtocol: Log seepage rates by area and compare with the approved project limit
Review flotation calculations for the governing groundwater condition
Confirm external groundwater levels are monitored without uncontrolled dewatering

name: Generic Flood-Level Protection for Openings
nameHindi: बाढ़ स्तर से ऊपर खुले भागों की सुरक्षा
source: RDSO draft Model DBR, Jan 2022 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic flood-resilience reference for station entrances, ventilation openings, and other surface penetrations.

specifications.Minimum Freeboard: At least 1.2 m above surrounding ground

inspectionProtocol: Verify each opening elevation against the current flood assessment
Inspect raised thresholds, covers, and drainage paths for obstructions
Record project-specific flood freeboard in the approved design register

name: Generic ECS & Smoke Extraction Arrangement
source: ACR Journal ECS article, 2012 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic environmental-control and smoke-management reference describing platform screen-door effects, end ventilation rooms, exhaust paths, and operating modes.
inspectionProtocol: Confirm the approved ventilation zoning and smoke-mode sequence
Verify fan duty ratings and end-room access provisions
Check measured air velocity and temperature against project criteria

name: Generic Metro Evacuation Performance Criteria
source: IIT Delhi evacuation paper, 2022 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic evacuation-planning facts for assessment and training context. They must not be interpreted as the approved Sadar Bazar evacuation calculation.
inspectionProtocol: Use the approved project evacuation model for operational decisions
Review pre-evacuation assumptions separately from travel-time calculations
Check accessible route assumptions against the final station layout

name: Generic Delhi Metro Stair & Escalator Reference
nameHindi: दिल्ली मेट्रो सीढ़ी और एस्केलेटर संदर्भ
source: IIT Delhi evacuation paper, 2022 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic Delhi Metro circulation dimensions included for comparison only. The station-specific staircase width remains governed by the station specification.
inspectionProtocol: Do not overwrite the Sadar Bazar staircase width with this generic value
Compare proposed circulation widths with the approved accessibility brief
Verify accessible egress continuity at every level change

name: Generic Finite-Element Station Mesh Guidance
source: IJITEE finite-element paper, 2020 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic numerical-analysis guidance for typical underground station models. It is informational and does not change the audited station geometry.
inspectionProtocol: Document mesh sensitivity before accepting analysis results
Use the approved Sadar Bazar wall and slab schedule for model inputs
Check that generic analysis guidance is not treated as verified project data

name: Generic PSD Cooling-Load Comparison
source: ACR Journal ECS article, 2012 (generic DMRC reference, not Sadar Bazar-specific)
description: Generic comparison of platform screen-door and non-platform-screen-door environmental loads for early-stage training context.
inspectionProtocol: Use the approved ECS heat-load model for design decisions
Confirm PSD operating assumptions match the signalling and ventilation systems
Record the source and confidence level when using comparison values
